high_level_description: The image features a person standing against a plain, light beige background. The individual is wearing a sleeveless, form-fitting dress that is predominantly pink with a gradient effect, transitioning from a lighter shade at the bottom to a darker shade at the top. The dress has a unique design with a large, abstract print of what appears to be a face or a mask on the front, which is also in shades of pink and white. The person has long, dark hair that falls loosely around their shoulders. They are posing with one hand resting on their hip and the other hanging by their side.
